recipes_later: Recipes will come with a later version of AIODOS: send a graph in API format.
graph_too_big: Graph too large (2 MB per graph, 8 MB in total).
graph_index: “graph”: the index of one of the graphs.
repeat_graph: “repeat.graph”: the index of one of the graphs.
vary_number: “vary”: a number already in the graph, and a step.
label_too_long: Label: a text of at most {max} characters.
model_incomplete: Model declared without a folder or a name: {{"folder", "name"}} (the hash alone will come later).
model_token_undeclared: Token @model:{token} without a model declared in “models”.
model_ambiguous: “{name}” is in several model folders ({folders}): declare it in “models”.
input_token_undeclared: Token @in:{token} without an input declared in “inputs”.
no_saved_output: This graph saves no file (SaveImage…): previews are not kept.
client_ref_invalid: “client_ref”: a text of at most 200 characters.
title: ComfyUI job
input_not_here: Input “{slot}” not found on this PC.
result_no_files: result without files, or with too many files
result_not_output: file from a node that is not an output of the unit
result_unknown_type: result file of an unknown type
